singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular wallet create [--config FILE] --vault FILE --network-magic N
       [--passphrase-fd N] [--trace LEVEL] [--trace-to SINK] [--trace-format
       FORMAT]

Create a vault with a fresh key

Draws a fresh payment signing key from the operating system's entropy, seals
it into a new vault file under the passphrase, and prints the key's enterprise
address for the network. It refuses a path that exists and leaves its bytes
untouched; a failed write removes what it made. The passphrase is asked twice.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

  A JSON file giving the settings the command line and the environment leave
  out.
  option: --config FILE
  env: SINGULAR_CONFIG FILE
  default: singular.json in the working directory, if there is one

  The new vault file to create; an existing path is refused.
  option: --vault FILE

  The network the address is built for.
  option: --network-magic N

  Read the vault passphrase, one line, from this inherited file descriptor.
  option: --passphrase-fd N
  default: ask on the terminal with the echo off

  How much to narrate: off, what (protocol steps) or how (also their
  mechanics).
  option: --trace LEVEL
  default: what on a terminal, otherwise off

  Where the narration goes: stderr or file:PATH; repeat for several.
  option: --trace-to SINK
  default: stderr

  The format of the narration: text for a person, json for a program.
  option: --trace-format FORMAT
  default: text on standard error, json in a file

Environment:
  SINGULAR_LOG  A file the protocol phases are appended to, one line each.

Example:
  singular wallet create --vault alice.vault --network-magic 1

Output and exit status:
  Prints the address on one line of standard output.
  Exit status 0 on success, 1 when the vault could not be made, 2 for a
  command line it refused.
